membacakan hasil penelitian.es: leer los resultados de una investigación en voz alta
membacakan hasil penelitian.en: read the results of an investigation out loud

membelikan tas kain.es: comprar una bolsa de tela para alguien
membelikan tas kain.en: buy a bag of cloth for someone

texto: The official unit stands out **meng-…-kan** in forms such as **membacakan**, **membelikan** and **mengajarkan**. Depending on the root and context, it may indicate that something is done for another person, something is transmitted to him or an effect is caused.
The root can change shape when receiving the prefix, and there is no single Spanish translation. See who gets the action, what the object is and whether the phrase expresses a result.
